compilerOptions.//strict: These are on from day one on purpose. Turning strictness ON later means paying for every unsound line written in between; turning it on at the start costs nothing.
compilerOptions.//paths: ONE alias source. Declaring aliases in both tsconfig and a bundler config produces two resolvers that disagree, and the divergence surfaces as an import that type-checks and then fails at runtime.

//exclude: Anything excluded here MUST name its replacement checker. An exclusion without one is coverage deletion that looks like configuration.
